### 1. boundary-rejection-redacted-to-generic-schema-error

|---|---|

| Diagnosis | `src/RoslynMcp.Host.Stdio/Tools/ClientRootPathValidator.cs:105-108` throws a plain `ArgumentException`, so `ToolErrorHandler` redacts the accurate boundary cause into a generic schema error. |
| Approach | A `workspace_load` for an absolute, existing path outside the sanctioned-root boundary returns a client-visible message that names the boundary as the cause, not `Parameter 'path' is invalid`.<br>The response no longer emits a `schemaHint` implying the path was malformed or relative when the path was well-formed and the boundary was the rejection reason.<br>The rejection stays free of information the boundary is meant to withhold — it names the cause, not the configured root paths, unless an existing disclosure rule already permits it.<br>A regression test pins the client-visible message for the outside-boundary case. |

| Validation | `mcp__roslyn__compile_check`; `mcp__roslyn__test_run --filter "ClientRootPathValidatorTests"`; full `just ci`. |

### 3. server-info-update-unknown-not-false

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| Route | `direct` |
| Diagnosis | `src/RoslynMcp.Host.Stdio/Tools/ServerTools.cs:278-300` computes a non-nullable boolean before checking `LastCheckStatus`, and `src/RoslynMcp.Core/Models/ServerToolDtos.cs:133-139` makes unknown impossible to represent. |
| Approach | `ServerUpdateInfoDto.UpdateAvailable` is `bool?`; `BuildUpdateInfo` emits `null` unless `LastCheckStatus` is `Succeeded`.<br>`checkStatus` of `pending`, `neverChecked`, `failed`, or `timedOut` all serialize `updateAvailable: null`, never `false`.<br>`succeeded` + no newer registry version still serializes `updateAvailable: false`; `succeeded` + strictly-newer version still serializes `true` with `latest` and `command` populated (existing `server-info-update-latest-inverted` contract unchanged).<br>`skills/update/SKILL.md` Step 1 reads the tri-state: `null` means the check has not completed. Its current "If `update` is `null`, the NuGet check hasn't completed yet" line is corrected — `ServerTools.cs:151` always emits the `update` block, so that guidance is already unreachable.<br>The `hooks/hooks.json` prompt hook gains an explicit `null` branch (stay silent / report "check pending"); today it branches only on `true` and on `update` null / `updateAvailable` false, so `null` matches neither.<br>Regression coverage for the pending case added alongside the existing inverted/newer cases.<br>Wire-shape change (non-nullable `bool` → nullable) recorded as a migration note in the changelog fragment: `server_info` is a published-surface contract and `ServerSurfaceCatalog` diffs `outputSchema` per tool (`ServerSurfaceCatalog.cs:417`), so the change is visible on `roslyn://server/catalog-diff`.<br>The embedded historical v2.3.1 catalog snapshot (which pins `updateAvailable` as a required boolean) is NOT edited — it is a frozen v2.3.1 snapshot; the resulting diff entry is the intended output. |
| Scope | Rule 3 exemption: tool-surface-only, 2 production files: `src/RoslynMcp.Host.Stdio/Tools/ServerTools.cs`, `src/RoslynMcp.Core/Models/ServerToolDtos.cs`. Tests (1): `tests/RoslynMcp.Tests/ServerInfoUpdateLatestTests.cs`. Docs/consumer policy (3): `skills/update/SKILL.md`, `hooks/hooks.json`, `changelog.d/server-info-update-unknown-not-false.md`. README companions are excluded because no tool registration or tier count changes. The release-managed sentinel is required for `hooks/hooks.json`. |
| Tool policy | `edit-only` |
| Estimated context cost | 45000 |
| Risks | Published additive-null wire evolution must preserve successful false/true cases, frozen v2.3.1 snapshots, and catalog-diff behavior. This initiative conflicts with the hook-prefix initiative on `hooks/hooks.json` and must run in a later generation. |
| Validation | `mcp__roslyn__compile_check`; `mcp__roslyn__test_run --filter "ServerInfoUpdateLatestTests"`; shipped-skill genericity gate; full `just ci`. |
| Performance review | N/A — status projection only. |
